messages:
samira: Heads-up 10am flight got canceled and the airline rebooked me on a higher fare itinerary that was non-refundable. I paid the difference on my card. Can we get reimbursed or should I escalate to travel team?
people-ops: Sorry about that. Short answer: reimbursable if you used the company booking flow and the rebooking was outside your control. If you booked personal the rules are stricter. Please attach the original e-ticket, the airline reissue notice showing the difference, and the card statement line. If the carrier offers a voucher you should use that first; we only reimburse cash differences.
carlos: Follow-up: I registered for a conference and paid the early-bird fee, then the company decided to send a different person. Refunds are processing slow. Can we submit the original receipt now and then a credit/refund adjustment later?
people-ops: Yes, submit the expense with the registration receipt now so the traveler gets credit for business spend. If/when the refund posts, upload the refund notice and finance will net it out. Make sure to note the reason and the alternate attendee name in the comments.
samira: The airline emailed a credit note, but it expires in 12 months. Does finance care if we use credit for future travel vs reimbursing now?
people-ops: Prefer to use airline credit for future company travel. If you think you'll leave the company before it expires speak with finance (special cases). If you must be reimbursed instead, provide the voucher code + expiration and manager approval for reimbursement in lieu of using credit.
amy: Question about upgraded seat after long delay. I paid for an upgrade at the gate due to delay and missed connections. Reimbursable?
people-ops: Upgrades due to operational issues may be reimbursed; upgrades for personal comfort are not. For eligibility: attach boarding pass + upgrade receipt + a short note from you and your manager confirming the operational reason (e.g., flight irregularity).
finance-bot: :money_with_wings: Reminder: All airfare reimbursements require either (a) corporate booking confirmation OR (b) manager approval + incident report if corporate card failed. FX conversions use the posted bank rate; if unclear include the card statement.
people-ops: Quick checklist to attach to the portal (Expensify):
- original e-ticket (pdf)
- supplier reissue/credit notice (email screenshot or pdf)
- card statement showing charge (screenshot)
- manager approval comment if booking personal
- conference registration receipt (if applicable)
Note: for refunds, upload the refund receipt when available and tag the expense "refund-pending".
samira: Thanks. Uploading docs now — ping me if anything else needed.
people-ops: Got it, well fast-track this on our side. If you see any automated denials, escalate to travel@redwood.example and include the thread link. :airplane:
